Fish: Biology, Ecology, Evolution, and Human Culture

Fish are among the most diverse and successful vertebrate animals on Earth. They inhabit nearly every aquatic environment, from shallow tropical reefs to the crushing darkness of the deep ocean. This document explores fish biology, anatomy, evolution, ecosystems, behavior, human interaction, commercial fishing, aquaculture, conservation, mythology, and scientific research.

Origins and Evolution
